selection_policy: Use only strict provisional PAIR examples labeled HARMFUL_COMPLIANCE in the encrypted-response development audit.
boundary_policy: Retain the smallest contiguous sentence block judged to preserve the requested harmful behavior without rewriting it; neutralize all complementary sentence blocks. Conservative boundaries are allowed when a narrower block would create unresolved references or malformed text.
